title: Assorted Free Standing Accessorie Towel Stand 49-Inch, 4 Pivoting Swing Arms, Solid Brass - | Satin Nickel | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom towel storage with an assorted free standing accessorie towel stand built from solid brass and designed with 4 pivoting swing arms to help maximize space without wall mounting in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms.

  • Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Stable base: heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping
  • Surface protection: felt pad helps prevent scratching

Specs
Material: Brass
Mounting type: Freestanding
Overall size: 49-Inch H x 12-Inch L x 10.5-Inch W
Weight: 13.6 lb
Assembly required: Yes
Included: Towel stand
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Coordinates well with traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.
